thread:
kevin: Quick heads-up — Redwood x StratusOne webinar confirmed for Wed 10:00am PT. Need final run-of-show + speaker decks by EOD Tue. Who's owning slide consolidation?

tara: I can do consolidation. Please drop slides to the shared drive and label with speaker name + slide owner.

maria: I'll upload demo assets. Hardware team will ship the device, but we need power strip & adaptor checklist for the in-person staging table. @simon-ops can you confirm on-site kit?

simon-ops: Confirmed. A/V team will be on-site at 9:15am for load-in. Bringing spare HDMI, USB-C, Mini DisplayPort adapters, and a macOS test laptop image. Ping me if you need a wired LAN.

jess (stratus): Great — we'll send a 60s pre-recorded demo clip (mp4) and a 2-slide summary of our integration by Tuesday noon. Also can share a short speaker bio.

kevin: Perfect. Action items I have so far:
- tara: consolidate slides (owner)
- maria: upload demo assets + swag inventory
- simon-ops: AV & stage kit (owner)
- jess (stratus): demo clip + bio

kevin: Also we need a courier plan for physical swag. Amount = 250 sample packs. Budget approved but need carrier + lead time. Anyone with carrier contacts? :package:

maria: I'll handle swag pickup and courier. Inventory will be posted here: `gs://redwood-assets/webinars/stratusone/swags-inventory.csv`

tara: For run-of-show draft, propose: 10:00 intro (5m) -> partner demo (15m) -> Redwood demo (15m) -> joint Q&A (20m) -> wrap and CTA (5m). Can we squeeze a 60s partner video before partner demo?

kevin: Yes, slot the 60s clip as lead-in to the partner demo. Add call-to-action slide with trial link. Use this RSVP link in slides: `https://redwood.ai/r/xStratus`

jess (stratus): We'll add the CTA and confirm the link works.

calendar-bot: Event created: "Redwood x StratusOne — Joint Webinar" — Wed 2026-05-06 10:00 PT. Zoom link: https://zoom.us/j/1234567890

simon-ops: Reminders: stage laptop must have the codecs for MP4 H.264. If partners bring a different format, we should have a transcode ready. I'll bring HandBrake presets and a small USB SSD with encoded files.

kevin: One more ask — can each speaker drop a 1-line talking point here? I'll assemble the moderator script.

tara: For Redwood: "How we reduce inference costs with workload-aware batching and caching"

maria: Hardware demo talking point: "Plug-and-play low-latency inference on partner-optimized GPUs"

jess (stratus): Partner talking point: "Seamless SI integration: deploying models at enterprise scale with our automation"

kevin: Awesome. If no blockers, I'll publish the run-of-show and finalize the deck order tomorrow morning. :thumbsup:

maria: Small logistics note — need customs docs for the device hand-carry if Stratus is shipping internationally. Jess, can you confirm export paperwork by EOD?

jess (stratus): On it, checking with logistics team now.

kevin: Thanks all. Final checklist to close before Wed:
```
- slides in shared drive (named)
- demo video uploaded to Zoom cloud & staging USB
- swag courier confirmed and tracking # shared
- A/V kit + test laptop staged at 9:15am
- moderator script + talking points
- Zoom registration + confirmation email templates
```

kevin: I'll ping again tomorrow with the assembled run-of-show and slide order.

jess (stratus): Thanks team, excited for the collab! :rocket:
